mapper.select: SELECT id, job_id, owner_epoch, storage_type, storage_namespace, object_name, url, status, claim_owner, claim_until, next_attempt_at, attempts, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by FROM manga_generation_media_object WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE manga_generation_media_object SET status = 'PUBLISHED', updated_by = #{actor}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND claim_owner IS NULL

UPDATE manga_generation_media_object SET status = 'RETIRING', claim_owner = #{token}, claim_until = #{until}, attempts = attempts + 1, updated_by = #{actor}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RETIRING', 'DELETED')
UPDATE manga_generation_media_object SET next_attempt_at = #{next}, updated_by = #{actor}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status != 'PUBLISHED'
